funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants

amount.raw: grants are for any amount up to £40,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed; one Research Project Grant per round per organisation
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art, visual culture and architectural history, contributing to a defined outcome or larger research project.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: tiered: Small up to £2,000; Large from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage who are the author or editor of the proposed publication; must have a publisher confirmed and publication date within three years
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals disseminating research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as image licensing, subventions and contributor fees.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants

amount.raw: grants are for any amount up to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; exhibition may be forthcoming or already taken place
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, disseminating research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants

amount.raw: grants are for any amount up to £3,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering venue hire, speaker accommodation and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants

amount.raw: grants are for any amount up to £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research or technical analysis; items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research on significant works of British art, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants

amount.raw: grants are for any amount up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of items and material in their own collections
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to make their collections freely available online via digitisation of photographic collections, archival collections, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications and other assets relating to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Opportunity: Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); membership application may be pending
opportunities.summary: Research travel bursary to help ERBA Members visit a library, archive, collection or site, meet a key contact, or attend a research-related event, covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (upper tiers require postdoctoral level or equivalent experience); open to international applicants
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals undertaking research travel and/or taking time to address specific research questions in British art, including staff replacement costs and supporting costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled to start (place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral level degree in British art, visual culture or architecture
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support (from the Andrew Wyld Fund) for registered students to undertake research trips to examine British works on paper (prints, drawings and watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years for part-time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, beginning between April 2027 and April 2028
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art, bringing new perspectives to our understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based institution, beginning between April 2027 and April 2028; international applicants may apply but amount is fixed at £32,000 per year
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research in the field of British art, covering university fees and living expenses, designed to expand understanding of British art through new perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 (paid at £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level (or equivalent experience) or above
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals looking to undertake a major research project in the field of British art that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, as well as an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
